definitions: To beat (a person or animal) repeatedly and violently with a stick or whip.
To move in a violent or uncontrolled way.
To defeat (someone) comprehensively in a contest or game.
To make (a way) by moving violently or with great effort.
examples: He was thrashed for stealing apples.
The fish thrashed about in the net.
They thrashed their way through the undergrowth.
